title: Alien Gate bullet audio stops after the bat-enemy sequence
symptom: Bullet sound effects are audible earlier in gameplay and then stop after the bat enemies fly, while firing and gameplay continue.
expected: Match the title's real-hardware behavior: bullet sound effects stop after the bat-enemy sequence and must not be forced to continue by an emulator-side audio workaround.

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: Alien Gate stops issuing or retaining the bullet sound map after the bat-enemy sequence. The emulator should honor the guest's CDIC audio lifecycle rather than infer that every later projectile requires a sound.
supporting_evidence: The same post-bat bullet silence is visible and audible in user-reviewed real-hardware footage.
Current E-Di behavior matches the sequence-specific transition instead of losing all title audio at startup.
Earth Command termination and other Alien Gate audio behavior remain correct under the current CDIC sound-map model.
contradicting_evidence: No bounded guest/CDIC trace has yet marked the exact bat-to-silence command boundary.
The earlier emulator report did not record whether firing occurred before or after the bats appeared.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: A synchronized real-player and emulator trace showing the real player continues bullet effects after the same bat boundary would reopen the issue.

manual_verification.notes: User compared E-Di with real-hardware footage at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vj0GFhxTsi0 and confirmed that bullet effects also stop after the bat enemies on hardware. The earlier no-bullet-sound report lacked a pre/post-bat checkpoint and is therefore contextualized as potentially observing this expected transition.
